jobs.description:
YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

Ready to help shape a more sustainable future with BNP Paribas Fortis?
 We’re looking for a Scrum Master who fosters trust, encourages open dialogue, and helps teams play to their strengths.
 If guiding delivery, aligning efforts, and empowering people is what drives you, let’s build something meaningful together.

 

AND IN DETAIL

Play a key role in building responsible, high-impact digital banking services. We are hiring Scrum Masters across multiple domains: Channels, Invest, Payments, Cyber Defence, AI, and more.
 What you’ll do:

• Join a multidisciplinary team of motivated experts, collaborating closely with your Product Owner to deliver high-quality applications in a fast-moving IT landscape.
• Act as a Servant Leader: support your squad by removing obstacles, managing dependencies, and helping them stay focused on what matters.
• Own the delivery: take full responsibility for turning ideas into deployed solutions,  coordinating across teams (Scrum of Scrums) and ensuring releases go smoothly.
• Coach your team: nurture a culture of feedback, learning, and continuous improvement within and beyond your squad.
• Build impactful solutions using modern technologies like APIs, Kafka, React, and AI, contributing to secure and seamless client interactions.
 

You’ll be part of BNP Paribas Fortis’ mission to accelerate sustainable finance through smart digital innovation. You’ll work in an environment that values empowerment, ownership, and trust. You’ll grow alongside people who believe in collaboration and shared success.

If you’re passionate about people, tech and purpose, this could be your next step.

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

What you bring to the team?

• A curious and proactive mindset, with the ability to stay focused and anticipate what’s next.
• The ability to create a psychologically safe environment where open feedback and learning are part of daily practice.
• A natural drive for collaboration, sharing knowledge and helping the team grow together.
• Strong leadership and coaching skills — capable of inspiring, aligning, and guiding the team through challenges.
• A critical thinker who isn’t afraid to question assumptions and promote continuous improvement.
• Confidence in taking full ownership of delivery, coordinating efforts across squads and ensuring smooth alignment.
• Solid grounding in Agile methodologies such as Scrum, Kanban or XP, with practical experience.
• A good understanding of software delivery from end to end — including infrastructure, cloud environments, networking, and system operations.
• Familiarity with modern engineering practices like CI/CD, DevOps culture, test-driven development (TDD/BDD), and infrastructure as code (IaC).
• An academic background in Computer Science, IT or a related field (Bachelor’s or Master’s degree).
• Several years of hands-on experience in a similar Agile delivery environment.
• Proficiency in Dutch or French, along with a good working knowledge of English.

Are you looking for a new challenging role where you can have a positive impact on digital transformation journey's ?

Join Capgemini as a SAP Solution Architect, and establish a long term relationship with our major customer, helping them optimizing their SAP transformation journeys.

 

CONTEXT

• As an End to End Solution Architect within Capgemini, your role is to help our clients in crafting, modelling and delivering a working end to end solution within one or more business domains.
• As a solution architect, you are involved in all aspects of an SAP project. During the design phase, you take the lead in creating a vision and a high-level solution, as a playing field for the different functional teams. During the build phase, you closely align with the technical architects to deliver a working solution, while monitoring the functional teams so that everyone adheres to the overall vision and solution. During the prep of the Go Live and the Go Live itself, you take the lead in guiding the client towards a successful transition and a smooth start-up.
• You work in tandem with the project manager, in a joint responsibility for the success of the project in scope, timeline and budget. You provide tactical input towards the steering committee, the delivery manager and the account manager. As part of the core team for a project or customer, you are the face of Capgemini and try to defend our interests, while delivering according to client expectations.
• Your role is to drive excellence for our clients through innovative (standard) SAP solutions crafting and strategic leadership and vision, optimizing performance and processes for sustainable business success.
 

YOUR ROLE

• Solution Design: collaborate with cross-functional teams to craft, design and implement a new and effective SAP-based solution that aligns with business objectives and best practices, based on SAP’s on-premise and cloud portfolio of solutions.
• Project Leadership: work closely together with the project manager and lead the functional teams, overseeing the entire project lifecycle from a solution and delivery perspective, ensuring high quality delivery according to client expectations, but also timely and within budget.
• System Configuration: keep in touch with the system and the latest SAP solutions and toolsets, in order to support our functional teams to configure and customize SAP to meet specific organizational requirements, ensuring seamless integration with existing systems and processes in or out of SAP; while sticking as close as possible to the standard of SAP
• Team Management: manage and mentor consultants of various levels of expertise; providing guidance, training, and support to enhance their skills and contribute to project success
• Internal management and contributions: As a senior colleague within Capgemini, you actively follow the latest developments, roadmaps, toolsets and strategic visions of SAP, and you actively share your findings within the Architecture Community and beyond.

YOUR PROFILE

• 10+ years of SAP project experience in a line of business, a sector or a solution suite, with proven knowledge in a SAP solution design and solution architect role
• Extensive knowledge of the latest SAP technology portfolio, on-premise, in the cloud (BTP, CALM,...) and ecosystem for your domain of expertise, and how to apply them in a clean core approach
• Knowledge of common non-SAP technologies that are used your domain of expertise, such as : GIS, Copperleaf, IoT, Field Service Management, transport management solutions, ServiceNow, integration platforms, automated warehouse management solutions, …
• A collaborative spirit & customer-oriented attitude, being able to lead both internally and externally
• Result-driven & focused on delivering quality, within the boundaries of a project and a contract
• Fluency in Dutch or French is mandatory and professional working proficiency in English

Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.

jobs.description:
Job description 

Welcome to the wonderful world of truck drivers! You will hit the road with an impressive tractor-trailer combination. Waking up early is essential, as you will be leaving between 5 and 7 in the morning. Don't worry, you are allowed to work around 12 hours a day, which is more than enough time to make the asphalt disappear under your fantastic vehicle. Of course, you are a true adventurer, so crossing a border occasionally doesn't faze you. Fortunately, most of it is national work, so you won't need an international driving license.

You will make between 4 to 6 stops a day, which means you will spend a lot of time on the road. Naturally, as a superhero driver with a CE license, you will be responsible for loading, transporting, and delivering various goods. Do you have experience with a fork truck (kooiaap)? Then you have an advantage. But don't panic if that's not the case, because you can still receive training for it internally. And if you're a true night owl, you can also take night trips for this position. The choice is yours! Just let us know.

 Requirements 

    
• Driver's license: CE + code 95.
    
• Knowledge of Dutch, French, or English.
